title: Japanese Empanada Teriyaki
description: A twist on traditional empanadas by combining Uruguayan dough with Japanese teriyaki flavors, perfect for a quick dinner.

ingredients.name: Uruguayan Empanada Dough
ingredients.notes: you can substitute with regular dough

instructions: Roll out the dough and cut into circles.
Mix the ground beef with a pinch of salt and black pepper.
Place a tablespoon of the meat mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Add a few pieces of green onion and a piece of shrimp on top of the meat.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops with teriyaki sauce and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve with a dollop of sour cream and a side of soy sauce.
